setup: One side of a triangle is extended to form an exterior angle, and the two interior angles not adjacent to it are \([[interior_a]]\) and \([[interior_b]]\) degrees.

steps.say: The three interior angles sum to 180, so the third one is \([[third]]\) degrees. That value is not the answer, but it is the bridge to it.
The exterior angle and the interior angle at the same vertex are supplementary, so it is 180 minus \([[third]]\), which equals the sum of the two remote interior angles, \([[exterior]]\).

answer: So the exterior angle is \([[exterior]]\) degrees.
